environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the stream processor with task role arn:iam::111122223333:role/StreamProcessorRole. The role has full DynamoDB access (dynamodb:*) on the jobs table with no condition keys. Kafka topic is writable by any authenticated producer in the VPC. Container runs as root with default seccomp profile (allows execve). No input validation on Kafka message payloads beyond JSON schema.
